subject: Kickoff: CamP Zip-NeRF quality reference pipeline
body:
Hi Deshawn, Milan,

Kickoff for the neural-rendering reference pipeline. Our open-source release bundles two methods in one JAX codebase: Zip-NeRF for the rendering quality and CamP for camera-pose preconditioning, which is what makes casually-captured scenes viable - poses from phone capture are never clean.

Product thesis for data-platforms: a scene-capture ingestion track where customers upload capture sessions and get a navigable scene. This window is about the quality reference, not serving.

Milestones (Feb 16 - Apr 27): M1 (Mar 13) environment + unit tests green (the repo ships run_all_unit_tests.sh - use it), repro of Zip-NeRF numbers on the NeRF Blender set. M2 (Apr 3) Mip-NeRF 360 dataset repro, plus CamP ablation on perturbed poses. M3 (Apr 24) capture-robustness report and a decision on the product track.

Milan is TL. Deshawn: staffing, compute, and the eval-data question.

Dmitri
